import datetime
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

output, *argv = sys.argv[1:]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
before = time.monotonic()
child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, start_new_session=True)
timed_out = False
try:
    stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=3500)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    timed_out = True
    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
result = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': os.getcwd(), 'started_at': started,
          'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic()-before, 3), 'exit_code': child.returncode,
          'timed_out': timed_out, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr,
          'environment': {'IN_NIX_SHELL': os.environ.get('IN_NIX_SHELL'),
                          'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR')}}
Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(stdout[-14000:], end='')
print(stderr[-12000:], end='', file=sys.stderr)
print(json.dumps({'record': output, 'exit_code': child.returncode, 'seconds': result['elapsed_seconds']}))
sys.exit(child.returncode if child.returncode >= 0 else 128-child.returncode)

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

binary, mode = sys.argv[1:]
events = []
canonical = {}

def call(state, operation, *args, expected=0):
    command = [binary, 'node', operation, *map(str, args)]
    if state is not None:
        command += ['--state-root', str(state)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    events.append({'operation': operation, 'exit': result.returncode})
    if result.returncode != expected:
        raise AssertionError((command, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr))
    return result

def protected(state):
    paths = ['startup-receipt.preserves', 'shutdown-receipt.preserves',
             'stop-control-receipt.preserves', 'control/node.lock.preserves',
             'control/current-run.preserves']
    paths += sorted(str(p.relative_to(state)) for p in (state/'receipts').glob('adapter-shutdown-*.preserves'))
    return {name: (state/name).read_bytes() if (state/name).is_file() else None for name in paths}

def prefix(base):
    state = base/'state'
    request = base/'shutdown-r.preserves'
    first_loop = base/'first-loop.preserves'
    call(state, 'init', '--node-id', 'node:f14-cli')
    call(state, 'run')
    first_binding = (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(None, 'control-request', '--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', request,
         '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
         '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64)
    call(state, 'control-submit', request)
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', first_loop)
    assert 'stopped=yes' in result.stdout
    assert not (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    original_control = (state/'stop-control-receipt.preserves').read_bytes()
    original_shutdown = (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(state, 'run')
    second_binding = (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_bytes()
    assert first_binding != second_binding
    assert not (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').exists()
    assert not (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').exists()
    return state, request, first_loop, original_control, original_shutdown

def positive(base):
    state, request, first_loop, old_control, old_shutdown = prefix(base)
    before = protected(state)
    call(state, 'control-submit', request)
    duplicate_loop = base/'duplicate-loop.preserves'
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', duplicate_loop)
    assert 'stopped=no' in result.stdout
    assert protected(state) == before
    assert not (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').exists()
    first_text, duplicate_text = first_loop.read_text(), duplicate_loop.read_text()
    dispatch = r'<dispatch-receipts \[([^]]+)\]>'
    assert re.search(dispatch, first_text).group(1) == re.search(dispatch, duplicate_text).group(1)
    result = call(state, 'status')
    assert 'node status running ' in result.stdout, result.stdout
    legacy_control, legacy_shutdown = base/'legacy-control.preserves', base/'legacy-shutdown.preserves'
    legacy_control.write_bytes(old_control)
    legacy_shutdown.write_bytes(old_shutdown)
    call(None, 'show', legacy_control)
    call(None, 'show', legacy_shutdown)
    fresh = base/'shutdown-new-request.preserves'
    call(None, 'control-request', '--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', fresh,
         '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
         '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64, '--evidence', 'blake3:'+'d'*64)
    assert fresh.read_bytes() != request.read_bytes()
    call(state, 'control-submit', fresh)
    current_loop = base/'current-loop.preserves'
    result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', '--receipt-out', current_loop)
    assert 'stopped=yes' in result.stdout
    assert not (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    completion = state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves'
    assert completion.is_file()
    call(state, 'status')
    canonical.update({'first_loop': first_text, 'duplicate_loop': duplicate_text,
                      'current_loop': current_loop.read_text(),
                      'current_run': (state/'control/current-run.preserves').read_text(),
                      'completion': completion.read_text()})
    return ['current-shutdown-stops', 'historical-duplicate-keeps-active-lock',
            'duplicate-retains-original-dispatch-ref', 'new-request-stops-current-run',
            'legacy-control-and-shutdown-stay-readable']

def negative(base):
    cases = []
    for damage in ['missing-run', 'malformed-run', 'unreadable-completion', 'conflicting-lock-run', 'historical-shutdown-artifact']:
        case = base/damage
        case.mkdir()
        state, request, _, _, old_shutdown = prefix(case)
        call(state, 'control-submit', request)
        if damage == 'missing-run':
            (state/'control/current-run.preserves').unlink()
        elif damage == 'malformed-run':
            (state/'control/current-run.preserves').write_text('<invalid-run>')
        elif damage == 'unreadable-completion':
            (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').mkdir()
        elif damage == 'conflicting-lock-run':
            lock = state/'control/node.lock.preserves'
            value, count = re.subn(r'<run "blake3:[0-9a-f]{64}">', '<run "blake3:'+'e'*64+'">', lock.read_text())
            assert count == 1
            lock.write_text(value)
        else:
            (state/'shutdown-receipt.preserves').write_bytes(old_shutdown)
        before = protected(state)
        result = call(state, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1', expected=0 if damage == 'historical-shutdown-artifact' else 1)
        if damage == 'historical-shutdown-artifact':
            assert '<decision "deny">' in result.stdout
            assert '<stopped "no">' in result.stdout
        assert 'stopped=yes' not in result.stdout
        assert protected(state) == before
        assert (state/'control/node.lock.preserves').is_file()
        cases.append(damage+'-rejected-without-lifecycle-change')
    state, _, _, _, _ = prefix(base/'legacy')
    call(state, 'stop')
    (state/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').unlink()
    before = protected(state)
    call(state, 'status', expected=1)
    call(state, 'run', expected=1)
    assert protected(state) == before
    cases.append('legacy-completion-cannot-prove-current-stopped-or-reset-lineage')
    return cases

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='molten-f14-cli-consumer-') as temporary:
        base = Path(temporary)
        (base/'legacy').mkdir()
        cases = positive(base) if mode == 'positive' else negative(base)
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True))
    if mode == 'negative':
        print('Expected current-run observation denials executed; lifecycle state remained unchanged.', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0 if mode == 'positive' else 1)
except Exception as error:
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    print(json.dumps({'events': events}), file=sys.stderr)
    print(repr(error), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
sources.review-consumer.py:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

binary, mode = sys.argv[1:]
events, canonical = [], {}

def call(root, operation, *args, expected=0):
    argv = [binary, 'node', operation, *map(str, args)]
    if root is not None:
        argv += ['--state-root', str(root)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    events.append({'argv': argv, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    if expected is not None:
        assert result.returncode == expected, events[-1]
    return result

def start(base):
    root = base/'state'
    call(root, 'init', '--node-id', 'node:f14-review-consumer')
    call(root, 'run')
    return root

def request(base, extra=False):
    path = base/('shutdown-extra.preserves' if extra else 'shutdown.preserves')
    args = ['--operation', 'shutdown', '--out', path,
            '--authority', 'blake3:'+'a'*64, '--policy', 'blake3:'+'b'*64,
            '--resource', 'blake3:'+'c'*64]
    if extra:
        args += ['--evidence', 'blake3:'+'d'*64]
    call(None, 'control-request', *args)
    return path

def protected(root):
    names = ['startup-receipt.preserves', 'shutdown-receipt.preserves',
             'stop-control-receipt.preserves', 'control/node.lock.preserves',
             'control/current-run.preserves', 'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves']
    names += sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in (root/'receipts').glob('adapter-shutdown-*.preserves'))
    return {name: ((root/name).read_bytes().hex() if (root/name).is_file()
                   else 'directory' if (root/name).is_dir() else None) for name in names}

def completed_with_pending(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    requests = [request(base), request(base, True)]
    request_values = {path.read_bytes() for path in requests}
    for path in requests:
        call(root, 'control-submit', path)
    receipt = base/'serve.preserves'
    result = call(root, 'serve', '--max-ticks', '1', '--max-requests-per-tick', '1',
                  '--receipt-out', receipt, expected=None)
    assert result.returncode in [0, 1], events[-1]
    value = receipt.read_text()
    canonical['completed-with-pending'] = value
    assert '<decision "deny">' in value, value
    assert not (root/'control/node.lock.preserves').exists()
    assert (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').is_file()
    assert '<stopped "true">' in value, value
    assert sum(member.read_bytes() in request_values for member in (root/'control/inbox').iterdir() if member.is_file()) == 1
    return 'completed-shutdown-remains-stopped-despite-pending-work-denial'

def repeat_stop(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    call(root, 'stop')
    completed = (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(root, 'stop', expected=1)
    result = call(root, 'status')
    assert 'node status stopped ' in result.stdout, result.stdout
    assert (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes() == completed
    canonical['repeat-stop-completion'] = completed.decode()
    call(root, 'run')
    assert 'node status running ' in call(root, 'status').stdout
    return 'denied-repeat-stop-does-not-invalidate-immutable-current-completion'

def unavailable_status(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').mkdir()
    before = protected(root)
    call(root, 'status', expected=1)
    assert protected(root) == before
    return 'unreadable-completion-rejects-active-status-without-lifecycle-mutation'

def unresolved_service(base):
    base.mkdir()
    root = start(base)
    shutdown = request(base)
    call(root, 'control-submit', shutdown)
    call(root, 'run-loop', '--max-requests', '1')
    old_completion = (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').read_bytes()
    call(root, 'run')
    (root/'control/current-run-shutdown.preserves').write_bytes(old_completion)
    call(root, 'control-submit', shutdown)
    before = protected(root)
    receipt = base/'serve.preserves'
    result = call(root, 'serve', '--max-ticks', '1', '--max-requests-per-tick', '1',
                  '--receipt-out', receipt, expected=None)
    assert result.returncode in [0, 1], events[-1]
    value = receipt.read_text()
    assert '<decision "deny">' in value, value
    assert '<stopped "false">' in value, value
    assert protected(root) == before
    canonical['unresolved-service'] = value
    return 'unresolved-historical-completion-propagates-service-denial-without-shutdown'

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='molten-f14-review-consumer-') as temporary:
        base = Path(temporary)
        if mode == 'pending':
            cases = [completed_with_pending(base/'pending')]
        elif mode == 'positive':
            cases = [repeat_stop(base/'repeat'), completed_with_pending(base/'pending')]
        else:
            assert mode == 'negative'
            cases = [unavailable_status(base/'status'), unresolved_service(base/'service')]
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True))
    sys.exit(1 if mode == 'negative' else 0)
except Exception:
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'events': events, 'canonical': canonical}, sort_keys=True), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
